description: District Cooling Projects by Project Status and Economic Activity is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset presents the number of district cooling projects and plants in Qatar, categorized by economic activity and project status. The indicators include project counts and plant counts, supporting analysis of the energy sector's cooling infrastructure and development trends. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are district, cooling, infrastructure, energy, projects. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-05-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
